test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the official language of the state of Manipur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meitei**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meitei** is the official language of the state of **Manipur**. It is also referred to as **Manipuri** and is spoken by the majority of the population in the state.
 
• Meitei is one of the **22 scheduled languages** recognized by the Constitution of India under the **Eighth Schedule**.
 
• The language belongs to the **Tibeto-Burman family** of languages and has a rich tradition of literature, culture, and history.
 
• In **1992**, Manipuri was officially included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution, elevating its status to a scheduled language.
 
• Meitei is used for **administrative purposes, education, and communication** in Manipur, alongside English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khasi:**

 
 
• Khasi is a language spoken predominantly in the state of **Meghalaya** by the Khasi tribe.
 
• It is classified under the **Austroasiatic language family** and is one of the prominent tribal languages of Northeast India.
 
• Khasi is not an official language of Manipur.
 
 
 
• **Mizo:**
 
 
• Mizo is the native language of the **Mizoram state** and is spoken by the Mizo community.
 
• It belongs to the **Tibeto-Burman language family**, similar to Meitei.
 
• Mizo is not recognized as the official language of Manipur.
 
 
 
• **Bodo:**
 
 
• Bodo is a language spoken by the Bodo people in **Assam** and other parts of Northeast India.
 
• It is one of the **22 scheduled languages** of India and belongs to the Tibeto-Burman language family.
 
• Bodo is not the official language of Manipur.
 
 
 
• **Meitei/Manipuri:**
 
 
• Meitei is the predominant language of Manipur and is widely spoken across the state.
 
• It has a unique script called **Meitei Mayek** and a rich literary heritage.
 
• The language is used in official communication, education, and cultural activities in Manipur.
 
• It is recognized as a **scheduled language** of India, providing it constitutional protection and support.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Scheduled Languages:**

 
 
• India recognizes **22 scheduled languages** under the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
 
• The inclusion of a language as a scheduled language ensures its **development, preservation, and promotion**.
 
• Meitei/Manipuri was added to the Eighth Schedule in **1992**, ensuring its recognition at the national level.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance of Meitei:**
 
 
• Meitei serves as a **unifying language** for various ethnic communities in Manipur.
 
• It plays a key role in preserving the **identity, heritage, and traditions** of the Meitei community.
 
• The language is integral to Manipur’s **folk songs, dances, and traditional storytelling**.
